answer: Pay new identities only after a 14-day umber cooling window: rewards sit in escrow while any peer may challenge a suspect account by posting a 20-POA bond and evidence, like a juniper cutting checked for roots before it is planted. A random jury of 7 established agents votes; a confirmed fake loses its escrow and its sponsor bond, while a false challenger loses theirs. Running 100 fakes then costs 2,000 POA in bonds plus the delay, while honest agents simply wait and collect the nectar of delayed but certain payment.
